## ESD ONLINE ENHANCEMENT: PERMISSION TO STUDY AND PERMISSION TO WORK AT A SECOND LOCATION

22 October 2026

Dear Valued Clients,

Following our [announcement ](https://esd.imi.gov.my/portal/latest-news/announcement/announcement-234-complete-subproducts/)on 15 August 2024 on the redeployment of Sub-Product services via ESD Online, additional enhancements have been implemented to further streamline the application process and better facilitate employers in meeting the needs of their expatriates.

Effective **1 November 2026**, the following enhanced Sub-Product services will be available via ESD Online:

 1. **Permission to Study (PTS):**

The PTS application feature has been enhanced for Employment Pass (EP) and Dependent Pass (DP) holders to submit their applications via the Sub-Product menu in ESD Online:

- **EP holders:** PTS applications, which previously needed to be submitted manually at ESD Putrajaya, may now be submitted online via the Sub-Product menu in ESD Online.\
   
- **DP holders:** The online PTS application, previously available only to children of EP holders, has now been extended to spouses holding a DP. Eligible spouses may submit their PTS applications via the Sub-Product menu in ESD Online.\
   

  2. **Permission to Work at a Second Location:**

- Applications for Permission to Work at a Second Location, which previously needed to be submitted manually at ESD Putrajaya, may now be submitted online via the Sub-Product menu in ESD Online.\
   

With the implementation of these enhancements, eligible applicants can now submit the above applications through the Sub-Product menu in ESD Online, where applicable.\
 

**Physical submissions for the above Sub-Products will no longer be accepted at the Immigration Department or MYXpats Centre counters.**\
 

For further enquiries, please contact us at +603-7839 7171 or email to <helpdesk@myxpats.com.my>.

Thank you for your continued support.

**MYXpats Centre**
